picker_dollies.configuration.title: Picker Dollies Configs
picker_dollies.configuration.maxBlocks.t: Maximum number of blocks supported per operation. In practice this limits the size of the initial selection.
picker_dollies.configuration.reachDistan: Maximum distance to be able to select block using the wand.
picker_dollies.configuration.wandItem.to: Item that will be used to perform operations using this mod. All the functionality of this item will be replaced, so pick something you won't be using.
picker_dollies.configuration.shouldRende: Determines if a preview for an operation result should be displayed, for example for a move operation this will be the blocks that will be placed. This feature is not super optimised, so disable this if you get frame drops.
picker_dollies.configuration.displayDire: When using the wand, displays an indicator next to your crosshair that shows which in axis the active area will move when scrolling.
picker_dollies.configuration.disableFree: Disables all operations, which allow the player to duplicate materials, for players in survival mode. This includes pasting from the clipboard, instead the cut operation will drop items.
picker_dollies.configuration.creativeFli: EXPERIMENTAL: Allows creative players to phase thought blocks during flight as if they were in spectator.
picker_dollies.configuration.cloneEntiti: EXPERIMENTAL: Operations that move or duplicate block in the world will also duplicate entities withing the initial selection. Be aware that there is no clean up code yet, when using the move operation, the original copy will remain in the original position.
picker_dollies.configuration.cloneContin: After stamping a copy using the clone operation, leave the clone operation active to smoothly create more copies.
picker_dollies.configuration.moveContinu: After moving a structure using the move operation, select the resulting blocks in a new selection.
picker_dollies.configuration.showSelecti: Show the initial selection even while an operation in progress. If this options is disabled, the selection will be hidden until the active operation is cancelled or applied.
gui.picker_dollies.copy_or_cut_prompt: Press %s or %s to copy or cut
gui.picker_dollies.start_operation_drag: Scroll or drag %s to %s (%s to select operation)
gui.picker_dollies.fill_with_target: Press %s to fill the selection with the selected block
gui.picker_dollies.fill_with_target_hint: Look at a block to fill the selection with
command.picker_dollies.clipboard.empty: There is no structure in the clipboard
command.picker_dollies.clipboard.interna: Operation failed due to an internal error, check the logs
